title: Another owner becomes an Ownership Gap without badgering

persona.name: Sam
persona.brief: Redirect tax-policy questions to the person who actually owns them.

mission.objective: Learn who decides whether an invoice is tax exempt.
mission.desired_outcome: Identify the decision rule and its owner, or preserve an ownership gap.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the answer for billing changes.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: Who owns tax-exemption decisions and what rule do they use?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: Billing must not invent tax policy.
investigation_results.relevant_context: Support receives exemption requests but does not define tax policy.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The rule and owner are known, or the identified external ownership is explicit.

turns.sourceQuestion: How do you decide whether a customer should be marked tax exempt?

answer.text: That is not my decision. Amina, our tax adviser, owns the exemption rule; I only apply the code she sends us.
